title: Mass Gospel Dialogue
text:
PRIEST: The Lord be with you.
PEOPLE: And with your spirit.

PRIEST: A reading from the
holy Gospel according to _____.
PEOPLE: Glory to you, O Lord.
(while making a Sign of the Cross with our thumb on our forehead, lips and heart)
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).

translation.latin: Dominus vobiscum. / Et cum spiritu tuo. / Sequentia sancti Evangelii secundum N. / Gloria tibi, Domine.
